parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables the table entry.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The status of this entry. {{enum}} The {{enum|Error_Misconfigured}} value indicates that a necessary configuration value is undefined or invalid. The {{enum|Error}} value MAY be used by the CPE to indicate a locally defined error condition.

parameters.name: TrafficClasses
parameters.description: {{list}} This list identifies the set of traffic classes associated with this flow spec.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: Flow queue network priority. Priority 0 is the lowest priority.

parameters.name: Latency
parameters.description: Maximum latency of the flow (expressed in {{units}}). Value 0 means no latency requirements.

parameters.name: Jitter
parameters.description: Maximum jitter of the flow (expressed in {{units}}). Value 0 means no jitter requirements.

parameters.name: PacketSize
parameters.description: Typical packet size. Value 0 means undefined packet size.

parameters.name: MinRate
parameters.description: Minimum required rate in Kbps. Value 0 means no MinRate requirements.

parameters.name: AvgRate
parameters.description: Average required rate in Kbps. Value 0 means no AvgRate requirements.

parameters.name: MaxRate
parameters.description: Maximum required rate in Kbps. Value 0 means no MaxRate requirements.

parameters.name: PER
parameters.description: The desired packet error rate (expressed in 1E-8, e.g. PER of 1.27E-6 will be presented as 127). Value 0 means no PER requirements.

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: Flow inactivity tear down timeout (expressed in {{units}}). Value 0 means unlimited timeout.

object.description: Flow specification table. The {{object|####.QoS.Classification}} table is used to classify ingress traffic, where {{param|####.QoS.Classification.{i}.TrafficClass}} is one of the classification result outputs. This ''TrafficClass'' value can be used to look up the appropriate {{object}} entry (i.e. the {{object}} entry whose {{param|TrafficClasses}} list contains a matching traffic class). For enabled table entries, if {{param|TrafficClasses}} is {{empty}} then the table entry is inoperable and the CPE MUST set {{param|Status}} to {{enum|Error_Misconfigured|Status}}.
